newsitem.title: USA: Boston Technology to supply SBC unit.
newsitem.headline: Boston Technology to supply SBC unit.

text.p: Boston Technology Inc said on Thursday it agreed to provide SBC Communications Inc's Southwestern Bell unit with $60 million of hardware, software and services.
Under the three-year agreement, Boston Technology said it would supply Southwestern Bell with its Access NP and CO ACCESS network services platforms, software and service applications.
The two platforms will allow Southwestern Bell to offer enhanced services, including voice messaging, call answering, fax services, virtual telephone and paging.
